Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc

Class CsvExporter

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.dbmanager.jdbc.CsvExporter
public final class CsvExporter extends Object
Exports a QueryResult to RFC 4180 CSV: a header row of column labels followed by the data rows, with fields quoted and internal quotes doubled only when they contain a comma, quote, CR or LF. SQL NULLs become empty fields.
